item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone!

For quite some time i was reading articles in this website and thought of joining the community and maybe add something from my own.

I am a new writer and don't have much experience but i hope i will get that experience as i read more and will be able to create my own work in the and with things i learned from everyone here.

I like mystery and SCP's that are hard to understand or has a deeper story than it looks like. I also like stories and articles that connect each other and make a lore of itself. This is something i also want to write about and i hope i will make a good SCP with that concept in the future.

Thank you for giving me this opportunity, and it is a pleasure to meet you all.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello Sputnik One! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

Well, as much as I believe you probably already know most of the stuff I'll say in this post, I'm sure you'll find at least one bit of helpful information - after all, you never know! Getting your first article to survive, especially as a coldpost, is quite impressive - I can't wait for what you'll write when you get critique - I'm sure it will be amazing! I can't wait to see what you come up with in the future!

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone ! My name is Fabrice and i'm from Canada.

I've been reading on the SCP universe for quite some time now and thought it would be a good idea to finally join the site.I speak french so reading and writing here will be a good way to improve my english. As of right now, I don't intent to write anything other than comments, but you know…if i gather enough courage maybe somedays i'll try my hand at it. For now, i'll just keep contemplating all the amazing ideas that everybody has and try to contribute to discussion.

At night i moslty think about things i could have done better during the day or about my future.. the boring usual stuff. Also from time to time i'll have the not so enjoyable to relive random embarrasing moment pop in my head.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey there! My name is Oleg. I'm 28 years old.

I don't even remember how I got into SCP universe, to be honest. It was a long time ago (around 10 years or so). I probably stumbled upon it on social networks and at first, I was like what the heck, is this real? lol, I definitely remember that. Since then I have been reading articles here and then and only now decided to join.

I'm an artist and spend a lot of time drawing and designing stuff. Also animating it. When I don't draw, I complain about the back pain I get from sitting all the time. And I actually have a YouTube channel with SCP comics which I will share here after I figure out the right thread to put them in.

At night I think about different random things. From my future and plans to stupid stuff like what if I had a hippo and had to feed it every day. Yeah, that sounds very stupid when I type it. Well, this happens only when I don't fall asleep quickly which happens most of the time.

Very happy and excited to join the community, cheers to you all!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Sup, I am BR0S3PH3R- As you can tell by my username. I am new to the S.C.P. foundation and I joined the wiki-group mainly because of how some S.C.P.'s have really inspired me to actually write, more specifically- S.C.P. 457. I really enjoy reading it because of the fire-aspect it contains!

As to what I want to do on the site, I want to write- and eventually evolve into commenting on others w/ good feedback. I don't believe I can give feedback just yet, though I am getting my first S.C.P. ideas down and working on them.

And that is pretty much it … if anybody has any fire or heat-related S.C.P.'s I'd be down to check them out…! :)

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Ah, dammit, I've accidentally reloaded the page.
Here goes take 2.

Hi! I'm Kleo.
I go by he/him or they/them pronouns, both are equally fine.

Why/how did I join the site
I've been lurking on-and-off here for years. Not sure how long exactly, but long enough that I can't remember how I first found the SCP community. It's occupied a part of my mind for a long time. I've had some ideas for anomalies, and also wanted to vote on some criminally good posts, so I've decided to make an account.

What do I want to do on the site?
Probably lurking for the most part. Commenting occasionally. Possibly writing. I'm not sure what combination of those things I'll do, so I'm using this thread instead of writing or reading. I've also got a list of skips that I've been intending to upvote.

+ show block
– hide block

What are some hobbies I have?
I enjoy reading and watching films, particularly horror, thrillers, and sci-fi (no surprise there). I like drawing too, and my total inability to draw proportions correctly just makes me better at drawing spooky stuff. I also really like this one website: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/ its like a creepy fictional organization that imprisons/contains supernatural entities. You probably haven't heard of it.

Any concerns or worries about the site I have?
I don't know, it seems like the site is set up well and the mods are helpful. No concerns I can think of immediately.

What kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?
Typically, just imagining hypothetical scenarios and deciding how they'd play out. Not sure why I do this, but I have been doing it for as long as I can remember. Also, as of late, something resembling depression. This is what zero physical interaction does to a mf.
(Seriously though quarantine has been absolutely horrible for my mental health, as I'm sure it has been for everyone else. I'm not used to being constantly unhappy, or even anything less than optimistic. Ever since [REDACTED]virus made it so I can't talk to people in person, I realized how much I rely on those interactions for my happiness.)

That's about it. Probably a slog to read because I'm not a great writer. Hopefully it wasn't too bad.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi everybody,

I've been a kind of background fan of the Foundation since high school and have always liked the clinical format and style of writing. I'm hoping to write a few SCP articles and explore some interesting ideas through them, think less 'oh god the universe is collapsing!' and more 'it's weird that this exists'.

I'm hoping to sharpen my writing skills here and get some good feedback from the folks with experience (criticism is not only accepted but welcomed). My own experience in writing has mostly been short fiction and personal projects so this seems like the place to be to develop that.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone. I recently joined this site thanks to my roommate who used SCP-001, or one of them, as a setting for a D&D game. Since then I've been reading every single SCP I can in my free time and have been gathering my ideas. I decided it was finally time to join so I can start getting to know the writing process and the formatting for the articles. As far as my hobbies go I like sports, videogames and D&D. I also spend my free time imagining things, machines, places, or events so I hope to put that talent to good use here.

Thank you all for having me here. hope to talk to all of you soon.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone! I found out about this place years ago, maybe from a YouTube video? It was a long time ago so I can't remember exactly; it might've been The Volgun. Only a month ago did I finally take the jump and make an account. Anyway, I already have one main list article on the site (that I'm not happy with to be honest, I'll rewrite it one day). Even so, it survived I guess? Not bad for what was basically a coldpost! Anyway, I thought I'd make the effort to formally introduce myself! I'm new to writing fiction, but I have experience in scientific writing (academic papers and whatnot), so I'm hoping to bring these skills to to table in my future articles. The biggest problem I have is actually coming up with decent ideas.

I currently have an idea on the Idea Critique Forum I'm hoping to have looked at before I take it to the draft stage.

So yeah, that's me. I hope I'll contribute something worth reading some day!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi!

I've known about this site for a long time, since middle school actually! After seven years of lurking in the shadows, I finally decided to join! I want to at least try to write a couple SCPs or anomalous items if a particularly nice idea hits and sticks.

I love to draw and think about the relatively impossible alongside things concerning cosmology/astrophysics and psychology.

The one thing I'm a bit worried about is grabbing a Sandbox page and using it correctly, but other than that I've wandered around the site a couple times.
